search_text: published ZDI-10-040 ZDI-CAN-545 Apple QuickTime RLE Bit Depth Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2010-04-02 CVE-2010-0516 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2010-0516 10.0 ['Apple'] ['Quicktime'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Apple QuickTime. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists during the parsing of samples from a malformed .mov file utilizing the RLE codec. While decoding RLE data, the application will fail to validate the size when decompressing the data into a heap chunk. If the length is larger than the size of the chunk allocated, then a memory corruption will occur which can lead to code execution under the context of the currently logged in user.
